# Zoo Lab

> Research laboratory and experimentation platform for Zoo Labs Foundation.

## About
Zoo Lab is the research laboratory and experimentation platform for Zoo Labs Foundation. It provides infrastructure for running AI experiments, publishing research, sharing datasets, and collaborating on open-source AI projects. Researchers can access compute resources, experiment tracking tools, and a community of peers working on decentralized AI and science.

## Key Features
- AI experiment infrastructure and compute access
- Experiment tracking and reproducibility tools
- Dataset hosting and sharing
- Research paper drafting and collaboration
- Open-source model development environment
- Jupyter notebook hosting
- GPU cluster access for training
- Benchmarking and evaluation frameworks
- Collaboration tools for research teams
- Integration with Zoo governance via ZIPs
